verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents search operators (docs-50), and complex search queries can also define Splits (docs-43). Its AI assistant can search the entire email history (docs-12), but only the last 90 days are imported by default, with a separate full-history import how-to (docs-48). A community report says free-plan search excludes mail older than 90 days, a plan-specific limit rather than a contradiction (comm-7). missing for 10: evidence of search speed, ranked/relevance-ordered results, detail on the operator and filter set, full-history search without plan or import caveats, independent hands-on corroboration.
